facts.fact: Proclamation No. 590/2008 on Freedom of the Mass Media and Access to Information, dated 4 December 2008, is proclaimed under Article 55(1) of the Constitution; its preamble affirms individuals' right to access information held by public bodies and a legal obligation on public officials to facilitate it (only the preamble is in the captured text).
